title: momentum_features row
description: Logical row for hypertable momentum_features (see shared/databases/migrations/007_momentum.sql). One row per symbol per completed trading day, holding every feature in MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §3 plus the §3.2 gate outcome. Computed from equity_ohlcv daily bars (interval='1Day', source='yahoo') — bars are not duplicated here. NO LOOKAHEAD: every field is computable from bars up to and including ts; forward-looking quantities live in momentum_labels. Percent fields are percent points (11.8 = +11.8%); pct_of_52w_high is a ratio where 1.0 = at the high; rvol_20 and vol_accel are ratios; market_cap, shares and dollar_volume are absolute.

ts.description: The bar date t, matching equity_ohlcv.ts

close.description: close[t]; denormalised from the bar because §4 penalties, §5 exits and §6 labels all reference it

volume.description: volume[t]; consolidated volume (§2.2) — single-venue volume makes every volume feature wrong

rvol_20.description: volume[t] / avg_vol_20. NULL when avg_vol_20 is 0 or fewer than 20 prior bars exist — never 0, never 1 (§3.4, §12)

vol_accel.description: mean(volume[t-2..t]) / mean(volume[t-7..t-3]). NULL when the 8-bar span t-7..t is not fully available

breakout_state.description: Judged on close[t], never on an intrabar high — a wick above resistance that closes back below is not a breakout (§3.6)

pct_of_52w_high.description: close[t] / high_52w. RATIO, not percent: 1.0 = at the high

vwap_20.description: Rolling 20-day VWAP (compute/vwap.go). Phase 1 stand-in for intraday session VWAP; field name is stable so the Phase 3 swap is one place

float_shares_est.description: ABSOLUTE share count. Shares outstanding used as an APPROXIMATION of public float — insider and locked-up shares are not excluded, so it OVERSTATES float for recent IPOs and insider-heavy names (§3.9). Present to the user as 'Float (est)', never 'Float'

float_is_proxy.description: Always true in Phase 1; exists so Phase 2 can discount the feature

rsi_14.description: Wilder RSI, 14 bars. Penalty input only (§4.3) — never a positive score, because a momentum breakout is supposed to have elevated RSI (§3.10)

catalyst_tier.description: NULL means not looked up (news is fetched only for gated candidates); 'none' means looked up and no company news in the window

catalyst_headline.description: Headline backing the winning tier, for the Discord embed. Every match is stored separately in catalyst_events

sector_strength_pct.description: median(change_pct_5d) across eligible universe symbols in the same sector. RECORDED, NOT SCORED in Phase 1 — there is no principled weight yet (§3.12)

change_pct_5d.description: (close[t]/close[t-5] - 1) * 100. Input to sector_strength_pct; not defined in §3.3, see SCHEMAS.md

market_cap.description: USD absolute, at t. §3.2 gate input and embed field

bucket.description: Assigned from close[t] (the two price bands are disjoint); NULL when price falls outside both

gates_passed.description: true = candidate. A gate failure means EXCLUDED, not low-scored (§3.2)

gate_failures.description: Empty array when passing, so 'evaluated and passed' is distinguishable from 'not evaluated'

short_interest_pct.description: Always NULL in Phase 1 — no acceptable free source (§3.9, §3.13). Column exists so the feature can be added without a migration

days_to_cover.description: Always NULL in Phase 1 — see short_interest_pct

is_halted.description: Always NULL in Phase 1 — LULD status is not on free/EOD data and is irrelevant to a once-daily post-close scan (§3.13)

premarket_change_pct.description: Always NULL in Phase 1 — regular session only (§3.13)
